text.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُۥ ظَٰهِرَةًۭ وَبَاطِنَةًۭ ۗ وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا هُدًۭى وَلَا كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّنِيرٍۢ

words.gloss_range: negative interrogative opening with rebuking affirmative force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening negative-question plus seeing formula

words.prose: {{ar:أَلَمْ}} ({{tr:ʾa-lam}}) opens with a question-form that already presses for acknowledgment: the audience is treated as having seen the evidence. The formula {{ar:أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟}} ({{tr:ʾa-lam taraw}}) also moves the discourse from private counsel into public summons, matching Quranic cosmic-evidence openings (6:19, 14:19, 22:65, 29:63, 31:29, 45:13).

topics.headline: question that presupposes seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by treating denial as failed acknowledgment, not by offering neutral new information.
topics.reason: The interrogative plus jussive-particle analysis supports the rebuking affirmative force.

topics.headline: public summons after counsel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Luqmān's counsel widening into a communal demand to inspect cosmic provision, with parallel formulae at 6:19, 14:19, 22:65, 29:63, 31:29, and 45:13.
topics.reason: The formula and boundary rows cohere with the plural address and discourse transition.

words.gloss_range: plural seeing that includes visual recognition, insight, and judgment
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, judging, and recognizing; locally the seeing is demanded as communal acknowledgment of providential order

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening negative-question plus seeing formula

words.prose: {{ar:تَرَوْا۟}} ({{tr:taraw}}) makes the seeing plural and jussive under the opening particle, so perception is imposed on the community as witness. The root range lets sight become insight and judgment, while the {{ar:أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟}} ({{tr:ʾa-lam taraw}}) plus subjugation formula links this seeing to cosmic proof (22:65, 31:20, 45:13). The plural form also marks this ayah as communal before later singular contemplation in the surah (31:29, 31:31).

topics.headline: plural obligated seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the evidence is placed before a whole addressed community, not only one contemplative individual.
topics.reason: The jussive 2mp parsing directly supports the communal-obligation topic.

topics.headline: seeing as insight and judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the requested seeing must become recognition and judgment, not mere visual exposure.
topics.reason: The root range is locally licensed by the perception verb governing a proposition.

topics.headline: formula and surah perception thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this seeing as part of a recurrent cosmic-proof formula (22:65, 45:13) and a Luqmān perception thread that shifts from plural to singular openings (31:29, 31:31).
topics.reason: The supplied recurrence rows are concrete and not contradicted by local grammar.

words.gloss_range: annulative hinge introducing the proposition that must be recognized
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾanna}}) turns the following provision clause into the content of seeing. The audience is not just asked to notice scattered phenomena; it is pressed to recognize a proposition: God has made the cosmic field serviceable and has lavished blessing.

topics.headline: seen content as asserted proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of perception is a whole asserted claim about divine action.
topics.reason: The annulative particle is syntactically forced as the complement introduced under the seeing verb.

words.gloss_range: the definite divine name as accusative subject of the perceived provision clause
words.root_gloss_range: worship, deity, and need-refuge pressure; locally the proper divine name anchors the provider before the later dispute about the same name

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: annulative particle governing the provision clause
later genitive reprise of the divine name as dispute topic

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) is the accusative subject inside the {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾanna}}) clause, so the provider is grammatically explicit. The name carries worship and need-refuge pressure into the two divine actions: subjugating and lavishing. Its later reprise as {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) makes the same one who provides become the topic of dispute.

topics.headline: definite provider as clause subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine agency is not inferred but grammatically installed at the front of the perceived proposition.
topics.reason: Case government by the annulative particle fixes the word as the clause subject.

topics.headline: need-refuge name under provision verbs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine name's worship and refuge pressure is answered locally by provision, while the local grammar still selects the proper name rather than an etymological gloss.
topics.reason: The root dispute can color the name's pressure, but the local surface remains the proper divine name.

topics.headline: same name at evidence and dispute poles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the same named provider becomes the later disputed topic.
topics.reason: The repeated divine name and case shift are visible in the local ayah.

topics.headline: misplaced recurrence claim
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The row discusses the later no-knowledge phrase rather than this local divine-name occurrence.
topics.reason: The row does not provide a word-level payoff for {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}).

words.gloss_range: completed Form II making-serviceable of the cosmic field for the addressees
words.root_gloss_range: subjugating, making serviceable, conscripting, and mockery branches; locally the Form II serviceability branch is selected with power-asymmetry pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: subjugation plus benefactive addressee formula

words.prose: {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}) presents cosmic service as an accomplished divine act for the audience. Its Form II shape and serviceability root make the act stronger than management: the heavens-earth contents are thoroughly ordered toward benefit. The formula {{ar:سَخَّرَ لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara lakum}}) belongs to a wider cosmic-benefaction pattern (14:32-33, 22:65, 45:13), while the mockery branch remains only a background power-asymmetry pressure.

topics.headline: completed act for the audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices cosmic service as an already accomplished divine gift directed to the addressees.
topics.reason: The perfect verb and benefactive complement support the topic.

topics.headline: serviceability with power-asymmetry pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices creation ordered into compelled service, while the mockery branch is limited to background power asymmetry.
topics.reason: Form II and local valence select subjugation/serviceability; other root branches do not replace the local sense.

topics.headline: recurring cosmic service formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this subjugation as part of a recurring formula for cosmic benefaction (14:32-33, 22:65, 45:13), not an isolated claim of power.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows include concrete parallels and fit the local phrase.

words.gloss_range: benefactive prepositional phrase marking the addressed audience as recipients

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later prepositional phrase with the same plural suffix

words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) marks the addressees as beneficiaries, not agents, of cosmic subjugation. The same plural suffix returns in {{ar:عَلَيْكُمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalaykum}}), so the audience remains the recipient through both serviceable cosmos and lavished blessing.

topics.headline: beneficiaries of subjugation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices humans receiving cosmic service rather than producing or controlling it.
topics.reason: The lām complement is licensed as benefactive after the subjugation verb.

topics.headline: same plural recipients across provision clauses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one plural audience carried from cosmic service into blessing coverage.
topics.reason: The repeated 2mp suffix is constrained by the same addressed audience.

words.gloss_range: unrestricted relative object opening the celestial contents
words.prose: The first {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) makes the object of subjugation unrestricted: whatever is in the heavens falls under the serviceability claim. Its repetition with the earthly phrase creates a paired exhaustive scope rather than a loose list.

topics.headline: whatever is in the heavens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object is not the heavens alone but everything contained within the celestial domain.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the explicit object of the subjugation verb.

topics.headline: paired relative construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices scope built by repetition: heavenly contents and earthly contents are separately included.
topics.reason: The second relative phrase is coordinated in parallel with the first.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition placing the relative object within the heavens
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the heavens a container for the subjugated contents. Because the same preposition returns before the earth, both domains receive the same container role in the merism.

topics.headline: heavens as container in parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah subjugates what is within the domains, with the heavens and earth aligned as parallel containers.
topics.reason: Both prepositional phrases are syntactically forced inside parallel relative clauses.

words.gloss_range: definite plural heavens as elevated, stratified upper pole of the totality
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, sky, and upperness; locally the definite plural names the elevated upper domain within the heavens-earth merism

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earth as the lower pole of the merism

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samāwāti}}) names the recognizable upper domain in the totality pair. Its plural form gives the upper realm stratified depth, and the elevation root makes it the high pole balanced by {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾarḍi}}).

topics.headline: definite upper domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the heavens as a known cosmic domain and first container in the totality sequence.
topics.reason: The word is definite, genitive after the preposition, and located in the first relative object.

topics.headline: stratified upper pole of merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices total creation organized as elevated layered heavens paired with the lower earth.
topics.reason: The plural form, root range, and heavens-earth pair all support the merism topic.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle giving the second relative object equal status
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second relative object under the same subjugation verb, so the earth phrase is equal to the heavens phrase rather than an appendage.

topics.headline: equal second object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earth contents receiving equal grammatical status under the subjugation claim.
topics.reason: The coordinator links two parallel relative-object clauses.

words.gloss_range: second unrestricted relative object opening the earthly contents
words.prose: The second {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) repeats the unrestricted object frame for the earth. Earthly contents are included with the same breadth already given to the celestial contents.

topics.headline: whatever is in the earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same unrestricted scope applied to the earth side of the merism.
topics.reason: The second relative pronoun is the parallel object of the subjugation verb.

words.gloss_range: second locative preposition completing the paired container construction
words.prose: The second {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) mirrors the first and makes the earth the matching container for the second relative object. The parallel syntax keeps the merism balanced.

topics.headline: earth as matching container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the syntax itself completing the heavens-earth pair.
topics.reason: The second prepositional phrase is syntactically parallel to the first.

words.gloss_range: definite singular earth as lower material pole of the merism
words.root_gloss_range: ground, land, soil, and terrestrial domain; locally the concrete singular earth closes the lower pole against plural heavens
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾarḍi}}) closes the lower pole of the cosmic pair. The singular concrete earth balances the plural heavens, making the totality asymmetrical: layered above, unified below.

topics.headline: earth as concrete lower pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earth as a concrete grounded domain, not merely the second item in a list.
topics.reason: The noun is concrete, definite, and governed as the earth-side container.

topics.headline: plural heavens and singular earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices total creation shaped as stratified heavens paired with one terrestrial domain.
topics.reason: The plural-singular contrast is local and structurally important.

words.gloss_range: coordinator carrying the same divine subject into the lavishing verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: coordinated lavishing verb
coordinated subjugation verb

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates {{ar:أَسْبَغَ}} ({{tr:ʾasbagha}}) with {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}) inside the perceived content. The same divine subject governs both acts: cosmic ordering and blessing coverage.

topics.headline: one agent for two provision acts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices subjugation and lavishing as coordinated evidence under the same divine agent.
topics.reason: The coordinator joins the two predicates under the annulative content clause.

words.gloss_range: Form IV causing blessings to be ample, complete, and covering
words.root_gloss_range: full extension, saturation, complete covering, dyeing, and armor-like coverage; locally the causative lavishing of blessings is selected
words.prose: {{ar:أَسْبَغَ}} ({{tr:ʾasbagha}}) shifts from serviceable cosmos to bounty that covers the addressees. The root imagery of saturation, full extension, dyeing, and armor-like coverage makes the blessings feel surrounding and complete; the armor link is concrete in 34:11. Its Form IV makes fullness caused by God, the rare perfect form concentrates the total-coverage image here, and the accepted sibilant-to-emphatic variant pressure makes the verb's sound density noticeable without changing the governing local form.

topics.headline: blessing as complete coverage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices blessing pictured as surrounding saturation, not only as counted favors.
topics.reason: The local object is blessings and the root branch supports fullness and coverage.

topics.headline: Form IV causes fullness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices God actively causing the bounty to become ample and complete.
topics.reason: The Form IV morphology supports a causative reading.

topics.headline: armor link and rare perfect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the total-covering image sharpened by the same root's armor usage (34:11) and by the rarity of this perfect form.
topics.reason: The intertext and rarity claims support the local coverage image without replacing the selected sense.

topics.headline: variant sound texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices accepted variant pressure around the coverage verb's articulation, while the canonical local form remains the governing surface.
topics.reason: The variant can be noted as phonetic texture but does not govern the canonical local parse.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus plural suffix marking blessings as directed upon the same audience
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْكُمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalaykum}}) changes the spatial feel of benefit: the cosmos is made serviceable for them, but blessings are made complete upon them. The repeated suffix keeps the same plural recipients under both divine acts.

topics.headline: blessings descend upon recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from benefit for the audience to bounty placed upon and around them.
topics.reason: The preposition is the complement of the lavishing verb and contrasts with the earlier lām.

topics.headline: same addressed audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the beneficiaries of subjugation are the same recipients covered by blessing.
topics.reason: The suffix coreference is strongly licensed.

words.gloss_range: His blessings as the object of lavishing, plural in the main reading and collectively classified
words.root_gloss_range: softness, ease, pleasant living, favor, and bounty; locally the plural possessed blessings are bestowed as life-softening provision
words.prose: {{ar:نِعَمَهُۥ}} ({{tr:niʿamahu}}) is the object made complete, and the suffix keeps the blessings God's even as they cover humans. The plural blessings are treated as one collective field by the paired states visible and hidden. The accepted singular reading sharpens the same comprehensiveness from the other side: many identifiable bounties or one encompassing bounty. The root's softness and ease make the gifts life-sustaining, not abstract favor only.

topics.headline: God's blessings as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the gifts remain God's possession while they are bestowed on the audience.
topics.reason: The noun is the object of the lavishing verb and bears a divine possessive suffix.

topics.headline: plural bounty classified as visible and hidden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices many blessings treated as one field with two states, visible and hidden, in a distinctive taxonomy.
topics.reason: The singular feminine circumstantial descriptors modify the plural object collectively.

topics.headline: plural and singular bounty readings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices comprehensiveness expressed either as multiple possessed blessings or as one encompassing bounty, while the local main surface remains plural and possessed.
topics.reason: The variant is meaningful but does not replace the main local form.

topics.headline: blessing as life-softening provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices blessings as conditions of ease that ground gratitude after restraint commands.
topics.reason: The root range coheres with the local blessing object and boundary movement.

words.gloss_range: apparent or outward-facing state of the blessings
words.root_gloss_range: appearing, being outward, surface, back, support, and manifestation; locally the active participial state marks the visible face of blessings

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: paired hidden blessing state

words.prose: {{ar:ظَٰهِرَةًۭ}} ({{tr:ẓāhiratan}}) is an accusative state of the blessings: they are encountered on their outward-facing side. Its active participle makes apparentness a live state, and its pairing with {{ar:بَاطِنَةًۭ}} ({{tr:bāṭinatan}}) divides bounty into manifest and concealed dimensions. The polarity also resonates with divine-name language at 57:3, while the local phrase applies the pair to gifts.

topics.headline: apparentness as blessing state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices apparentness as a state in which blessings are encountered, not a separate object.
topics.reason: The word is an accusative active participle functioning as circumstantial state.

topics.headline: visible side of paired blessing field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices blessings classified by outward visibility and inward hiddenness, not merely counted.
topics.reason: The root image and paired opposite support the visible-hidden taxonomy.

topics.headline: divine-name polarity applied to gifts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the visible-hidden pair resonating with 57:3, while the local referent remains blessings rather than divine names.
topics.reason: The intertextual polarity is valid but must be limited to resonance because the local noun modified is blessings.

topics.headline: hidden gifts do not license ignorance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hidden blessing calls for humility, while the later no-knowledge dispute turns hiddenness into indictment.
topics.reason: The emergent row links the visible-hidden taxonomy with the later epistemic failure without contradicting local grammar.

words.gloss_range: coordinator binding two blessing states into one polarity
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the apparent and hidden states into one classification. It does not start a new event; it completes the visible-hidden polarity of the blessings.

topics.headline: two states as one polarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two descriptors joined into a full visible-hidden taxonomy.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates two circumstantial descriptors of the same blessing object.

words.gloss_range: hidden or inward state of the blessings
words.root_gloss_range: belly, interior, lining, concealment, and inwardness; locally the active participial state makes concealed provision explicit

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: paired apparent blessing state

words.prose: {{ar:بَاطِنَةًۭ}} ({{tr:bāṭinatan}}) mirrors {{ar:ظَٰهِرَةًۭ}} ({{tr:ẓāhiratan}}) as a second accusative participial state. The root's belly, interior, and lining imagery gives hidden blessing concrete inwardness, so concealed provision is as textually present as visible provision. The pair forms an exhaustive binary and resonates with wider visible-hidden polarity (57:3, 6:120, 7:33), while the local application is uniquely blessing-focused.

topics.headline: hiddenness as matched state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hiddenness placed in the same syntactic role as visible blessing.
topics.reason: The word matches the preceding participle in case and function.

topics.headline: interior imagery of concealed provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hidden blessings as inward and lining-like, not merely absent from view.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports concrete interiority while local grammar selects hidden blessing.

topics.headline: visible-hidden totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the blessing field covered whether accessible to perception or concealed from it.
topics.reason: The matched participles form the local binary taxonomy.

topics.headline: wider polarity applied to blessings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pair's wider Quranic polarity (57:3, 6:120, 7:33), while local grammar keeps the referent as blessings.
topics.reason: The intertextual polarity is meaningful but cannot override the local blessing taxonomy.

topics.headline: hidden provision and failed recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from unrecognized sound to concealed blessings and finally to human argument without knowledge.
topics.reason: The boundary row supplies a coherent discourse payoff connected to the local hidden-blessing term.

words.gloss_range: resumptive or adversative transition into the human-disputant clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from the evidence of provision to a rebuked human subset. The new clause is declarative in form, but its placement after cosmic service and layered blessing makes it an indictment.

topics.headline: pivot into disputant rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the argumentative turn from abundant evidence to the person who argues despite it.
topics.reason: The fronted partitive phrase starts a new clause after the provision sequence.

topics.headline: declarative with condemning force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that naming the human subset already rebukes it by contrast with the evidence just listed.
topics.reason: The clause formation and discourse position support rebuking speech-act force.

words.gloss_range: partitive preposition isolating some from humankind
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) narrows the blame to a subset of people. After the plural audience has been summoned to see, this partitive phrase distinguishes the disputant from the witnessing community.

topics.headline: some among people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the indictment targets a subset, not humanity without distinction.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the definite people noun in a partitive fronted phrase.

topics.headline: from sensory excess to social argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices disorder moving from the previous sensory image into human society as argument without knowledge.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives a coherent transition payoff tied to the partitive human phrase.

words.gloss_range: humankind or people as the social field from which the disputant subset is drawn
words.root_gloss_range: human sociability, familiarity, perception, with a supplied forgetfulness alternative; locally the definite people form names the human collective
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) supplies the social field: the disputant is from among people, not outside humanity. The sociability and familiarity pressure makes the failure sharper, and the forgetfulness alternative can be kept as a secondary pressure: the human type belongs to a shared evidence field yet fails to recognize it. The phrase also recalls another local human profile at 31:6.

topics.headline: human collective with sociability pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the disputant as socially human and therefore accountable within a shared field of recognizable evidence.
topics.reason: The sociability and forgetfulness pressures can color the people noun, while the local sense remains the human collective.

topics.headline: repeated people-without-knowledge profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices {{ar:وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:wa-mina l-nāsi}}) as a repeated local profile of misdirected human behavior (31:6, 31:20).
topics.reason: The same-surah recurrence is concrete and fits the local phrase.

topics.headline: from addressed recipients to third-person subset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the disputant excluded from the addressed witnessing community while still named as part of humanity.
topics.reason: The shift from second-person suffixes to third-person partitive phrase is visible in the ayah.

words.gloss_range: singular relative pronoun forming an archetypal disputant class
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) compresses the blamed subset into a singular representative: whoever disputes. After plural address, the singular foil keeps the condemnation concrete rather than faceless.

topics.headline: singular representative of a class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one grammatical figure standing for a broader disputant type.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is singular in form and heads the relative clause.

topics.headline: individualized contrast after plural address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the public audience contrasted with an individualizable foil.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the shift from plural address to singular relative subject.

words.gloss_range: ongoing Form III disputation about God
words.root_gloss_range: argument, reciprocal contest, rope-twisting, and wrestling; locally the imperfect Form III profiles a continuing disputant engaged in contention

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: recurring phrase for disputing about God

words.prose: {{ar:يُجَٰدِلُ}} ({{tr:yujādilu}}) defines the figure by ongoing disputation, not a single objection. The root images of rope-twisting and wrestling make the argument feel combative and contorted, while Form III profiles engagement with another rather than solitary doubt. The phrase {{ar:يُجَٰدِلُ فِي ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:yujādilu fī Allāhi}}) recurs in the no-knowledge polemic (22:3, 22:8, 31:20).

topics.headline: ongoing disputation profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the person characterized by continuing argument, not by a one-time question.
topics.reason: The imperfect indicative supports ongoing or characteristic action.

topics.headline: argument as twisting and struggle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices disputation pictured as wrangling and contorted struggle rather than transparent reasoning.
topics.reason: The root imagery is locally compatible with the dispute verb.

topics.headline: interactive contest, not collective mutual quarrel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices engagement with an opponent or interlocutor, while the local form profiles the disputant rather than distributing quarrel across a group.
topics.reason: Form III supports interactive contestation; the supplied contrast with Form VI narrows the scope.

topics.headline: formula of disputing about God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase as part of a recurring groundless-God-dispute formula (22:3, 22:8, 31:20).
topics.reason: The exact phrase recurrence is concrete and supports the local polemical force.

words.gloss_range: topical preposition marking God as the domain of dispute

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: topical prepositional phrase marking God as dispute domain

words.prose: Here {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) shifts from spatial containment to topic: earlier it located contents in heavens and earth, but now {{ar:فِي ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:fī Allāhi}}) marks the domain of dispute. The same preposition carries the ayah from cosmic containers to a conceptual field of argument.

topics.headline: same preposition becomes topic marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the preposition moving from the cosmos as container to God as the topic of dispute.
topics.reason: The local attachment marks {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) as the topical complement of the dispute verb.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine name governed as the topic of dispute
words.root_gloss_range: worship, deity, and need-refuge pressure; locally the proper name is the governed dispute topic after already being the provider-agent

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: topical preposition governing the divine name
earlier accusative divine name as provider-agent

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is genitive after topical {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}), so the same name that stood as provider-agent now stands inside the dispute. The case shift from {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) to {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) tracks the ayah's irony: the one who subjugates and lavishes becomes the one about whom the disputant argues without warrant.

topics.headline: provider name becomes governed topic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the case shift marking a move from divine agent of provision to divine topic of dispute.
topics.reason: The word is genitive after the topical preposition and contrasts with the earlier accusative occurrence.

topics.headline: same provider becomes disputed domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the indictment sharpened by repetition: the provider-name is the disputed domain.
topics.reason: The repeated divine name binds the provision and dispute segments.

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches {{ar:غَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:ghayri ʿilmin}}) to the disputing verb as the manner or accompaniment of the argument. The problem is not only that knowledge is absent somewhere; the argument proceeds with absence as its condition.

topics.headline: absence attached to the act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices lack of knowledge characterizing how the disputation is carried out.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the phrase attached to the dispute verb.

words.prose: {{ar:غَيْرِ}} ({{tr:ghayri}}) is not a bare negative particle; it is a genitive construct noun governing {{ar:عِلْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʿilmin}}). The grammar makes absence the disputant's accompaniment, and the root's otherness pressure marks the argument as proceeding from outside knowledge.

topics.headline: absence built as construct relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices absence of knowledge built structurally into the dispute, not merely added as a loose negative.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the preposition and governs the following genitive noun.

topics.headline: outside-knowledge pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the dispute as alienated from knowledge, while the local idiom remains simple exclusion: without knowledge.
topics.reason: The otherness root pressure is valid but must be limited by the local idiom.

topics.headline: unrecognized sound becomes ignorance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a discourse movement from what resists recognition to disputation from no knowledge.
topics.reason: The boundary row is coherent with the no-knowledge phrase and does not contradict local grammar.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional no-knowledge formula

words.prose: {{ar:عِلْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʿilmin}}) is the first missing warrant. As a verbal noun, it names knowledge itself rather than a missing expert, and it begins the triad of no knowledge, no guidance, and no illuminating book. The phrase {{ar:بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:bi-ghayri ʿilmin}}) is a formula for groundless dispute about God (22:3, 22:8, 31:20), and the triad collides with the opening command to see abundant provision.

topics.headline: knowledge begins the absence chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the dispute lacking epistemic substance before guidance and text are also denied.
topics.reason: The verbal noun is the governed noun in the no-knowledge phrase and heads the coordinated absence chain.

topics.headline: recurring no-knowledge formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices {{ar:بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:bi-ghayri ʿilmin}}) as a recurrent formula for groundless God-dispute (22:3, 22:8, 31:20).
topics.reason: The recurrence rows provide concrete parallels.

topics.headline: knowledge, guidance, and illuminating text absent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the indictment escalating across three channels: cognition, direction, and illuminating textual authority.
topics.reason: The local coordinated sequence supports the triad and its intensification.

topics.headline: seen provision answered by no warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah-level contradiction between abundant visible provision and structurally empty disputation.
topics.reason: The emergent row coheres with the ayah's movement from seeing provision to negated warrants.

words.gloss_range: coordinator extending the negation series beyond the construct phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional no-knowledge formula

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the indictment beyond {{ar:بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:bi-ghayri ʿilmin}}). It adds guidance as a separate missing warrant instead of merely restating ignorance.

topics.headline: second warrant added
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance added as its own absence after lack of knowledge.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the next negated warrant in the series.

words.gloss_range: negative particle giving guidance its own denied scope

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: guidance as the second missing warrant

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) gives {{ar:هُدًۭى}} ({{tr:hudan}}) independent negative scope. The repeated pattern evaluates the disputant by zero warrants: no knowledge, no guidance, no illuminating book.

topics.headline: guidance separately denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance denied independently, intensifying the three-point absence.
topics.reason: The negative particle precedes the second warrant and participates in the repeated negation pattern.

words.gloss_range: guidance as an unrestricted missing route-quality and second epistemic source
words.root_gloss_range: guidance, showing a way, direction, leading, gift, offering, and manner; locally guidance or directed wayfinding is the selected missing warrant
words.prose: {{ar:هُدًۭى}} ({{tr:hudan}}) is denied as any guidance at all. The root makes the missing warrant directional: the disputant lacks a route or leading, not just information. As a verbal noun, it names guidance as a quality or path, and its negation recalls the surah's opening guidance profile (31:3, 31:5) now absent from the disputant.

topics.headline: indefinite guidance under negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no kind of guidance is allowed as warrant for the dispute.
topics.reason: The indefinite noun under negation supports an unrestricted absence reading.

topics.headline: guidance as direction, not information only
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the missing warrant as orientation and pathfinding beyond raw knowledge.
topics.reason: The root range and maṣdar form support guidance as route-quality.

topics.headline: opening guidance now absent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a term central to the surah's opening guidance frame (31:3, 31:5) now negated for the disputant.
topics.reason: The same-surah echo is concrete and supports the local contrast.

words.gloss_range: coordinator adding textual authority as the final negated tier
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds a third warrant after knowledge and guidance. The sequence now moves to documented authority: no illuminating book.

topics.headline: third warrant added
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices textual authority added as the final tier of the missing-warrant sequence.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the final negated warrant in the series.

words.gloss_range: second negative particle giving book its own denied scope
words.prose: The second {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) independently denies any book. Textual authority is not treated as a subset of guidance; it receives its own zero mark.

topics.headline: book separately denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices textual authority denied as a distinct category after knowledge and guidance.
topics.reason: The repeated negative particle gives the following noun independent negative scope.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite book or written authority denied with its illuminating adjective
words.root_gloss_range: writing, inscription, prescription, decree, binding, and joining; locally the noun names documented authority qualified by illumination

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: illuminating adjective modifying book
illuminating book phrase

words.prose: {{ar:كِتَٰبٍۢ}} ({{tr:kitābin}}) completes the sequence of missing warrants as documented authority. Because {{ar:مُنِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:munīrin}}) agrees with it, the denied object is not any text only but any illuminating text. The root's writing, decreeing, and binding pressure makes the missing source an organized authority, and the phrase {{ar:كِتَٰبٍۢ مُنِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:kitābin munīrin}}) recurs as a light-bearing authority formula (22:8, 31:20, 35:25).

topics.headline: any illuminating text denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied warrant is any book with illuminating quality, not merely one specific scripture.
topics.reason: The indefinite noun and agreeing adjective form one denied noun-adjective pair.

topics.headline: documented authority as final warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequence climaxing in the strongest external warrant: documented authority.
topics.reason: The noun is the third item in the coordinated absence series.

topics.headline: writing and binding pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices textual authority as organized and binding, while the local sense remains book or written warrant.
topics.reason: The root dispute can sharpen authority but should not replace the local noun sense.

topics.headline: light-bearing authority formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices {{ar:كِتَٰبٍۢ مُنِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:kitābin munīrin}}) as a recurring formula for illuminating authority (22:8, 31:20, 35:25).
topics.reason: The exact phrase recurrence is concrete and supports the local formulaic force.

words.gloss_range: Form IV active participle describing a book that produces illumination
words.root_gloss_range: light, illumination, clarity, fire-related contrast, markers, and visible signs; locally the Form IV participle selects clarity-producing illumination
words.prose: {{ar:مُنِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:munīrin}}) qualifies the missing book as illumination-producing. The Form IV active participle makes the absent authority something that would actively cause clarity, not merely possess brightness. The root's light field can be contrasted with fire imagery, but the local adjective selects clarifying illumination. Its absence climaxes the indictment: no text that can light the way, with resonance from the wider Quranic light field (24:35) and the recurring formula (22:8, 35:25).

topics.headline: active illumination as adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the missing book would actively produce clarity, not merely contain information.
topics.reason: The Form IV active participle agrees with the book noun as its adjective.

topics.headline: clarifying light selected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices cognitive illumination and clarification, while fire-related root associations remain contrastive rather than selected.
topics.reason: The adjective attached to book selects illumination and clarity; destructive fire is not the local sense.

topics.headline: wider light field resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the absent book resonating with the Quranic light field (24:35), while the local claim remains the lack of an illuminating textual warrant.
topics.reason: The light-field reference is valid as resonance but should not override the local adjective.

topics.headline: indefinite sound pattern and final climax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated indefinite endings carrying the absence chain into a final climax: no authority that can illuminate.
topics.reason: The adjective closes the negated noun phrase and the emergent row coheres with the local final position.

baseline_models.mechanism: The opening summons eye and insight to read benefit across disclosed and interior layers; the paired adjectives turn seeing into an evidentiary task rather than a glance.

activation_trace.role: Eye-and-insight perception supplies the observing act and makes it evidentiary.
Emergence and disclosure supply the outward layer of benefit.
A hidden inward reality supplies the concealed layer that reflection must infer.

changed_reading.before: The question merely points to obvious blessings.
changed_reading.after: The question demands perception across both manifest effects and concealed interiors, making incomplete seeing part of the verse's problem.

baseline_models.mechanism: Subjection directs diverse creation toward a human-serving end, while completion and covering make blessing an encompassing habitat rather than a list of possessions.

activation_trace.role: Taming and driving toward a purpose supply coordinated service rather than inert availability.
Completion and full measure make the benefit system comprehensive.
Length and breadth until covering supply the enveloping geometry of blessing upon the recipients.
Good condition and favor name the resulting lived state, not merely its component goods.

changed_reading.before: Heavenly and earthly things are simply available for human use.
changed_reading.after: A coordinated creation is directed into a complete, covering field of benefit within which human life operates.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُجَادِلُ ... بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: Disputation can be tightly twisted and formally forceful while lacking three distinct bearings: disclosed recognition, directional guidance, and a joined, illuminating record.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the image of an argument whose strands can look internally coherent.
Entangled contest supplies the social action of adversarial disputing.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the missing recognitional ground.
Gentle direction to a path supplies the missing orientation.
An inscription that establishes obligation supplies the missing accountable standard.
Light and illumination supply the missing capacity to make the standard publicly legible.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns argument caused by generic ignorance.
changed_reading.after: It exposes a possibly well-braided argument that has no disclosed ground, no route, and no illuminating standard by which its force can be tested.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening presents the wise book as guidance and mercy, so the focus triad is an inversion of already supplied means rather than a neutral inventory of absent credentials.

activation_trace.role: Direction toward the path anchors the focus verse's explicitly missing guidance.
Illumination anchors the focus demand that a cited book actually clarify.
Joined letters and a written object supply the concrete book announced before the dispute.
Gentle path-direction identifies that announced book's operative function.

structural_cues: 31:2-5 sequence book, guidance, mercy, practice, and success before 31:20 negates guidance and illuminating book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the opening book-guidance sequence and the focus negations; I infer availability followed by refusal or detachment. Alternatively, the recurrence may only classify sound and unsound speakers without implying deliberate refusal.

changed_reading.before: The disputant happens not to possess adequate sources.
changed_reading.after: The disputant speaks outside a guidance system the surah has already placed in view, making the deficit relational as well as informational.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored person in 31:6 acquires distracting discourse, diverts from a path, and converts signs into mockery; this recasts focus disputation as participation in an economy of attention rather than an isolated intellectual error.

activation_trace.role: Entangled contest anchors the focus action that the earlier discourse economy helps explain.
Commercial exchange supplies acquisition and circulation as the social mechanism.
Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies attention capture.
Deviation from guidance and purpose supplies the effect of the captured attention.
A traversable extended path supplies what the distracting discourse diverts people from.
Ridicule supplies the terminal social posture of the diversion.

structural_cues: 31:6 and 31:20 repeat وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن and بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ; 31:7 then stages proud turning and simulated deafness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated human type plus exchange, distraction, deviation, and mockery; I infer a causal chain from attention capture to disputation. Alternatively, 31:6 and 31:20 may portray separate offenders whose shared syntax only marks a class.

changed_reading.before: A person spontaneously argues from ignorance.
changed_reading.after: The argument can be the downstream product of purchased, circulating distraction that first displaces the path and then rewards ridicule.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible cosmic order is paired with support, stabilization, and prevented oscillation, then with a demand to show rival creation; outward blessing becomes the readable result of operations not themselves foregrounded.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the visible outcome side of the focus pair.
Hidden interiority anchors the unexposed operative side of the focus pair.
Support by a prop supplies the question of what holds an ordered expanse up.
Firm settling supplies the stabilizing operation visible through its effects.
Oscillation and tilting supply the movement that stabilization prevents.
Making something visible supplies the evidentiary challenge to display an alternative creation.

structural_cues: 31:10 juxtaposes the seen heavens with support language, fixed mountains, and prevented swaying; 31:11 answers with an imperative to show.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies support, stabilization, prevented motion, and showing; I infer an unseen-operation to visible-habitability arrow. The live alternative is that 31:10 denies pillars altogether rather than positing invisible pillars, so the model rests on hidden operations generally, not hidden columns specifically.

changed_reading.before: Visible and hidden blessings are two static categories.
changed_reading.after: The visible world can be read as the output layer of concealed stabilizing operations, and seeing properly means tracing effect back toward support.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to thank is grounded in pregnancy, repeated weakness, and eventual weaning; blessing's hidden layer becomes bodily labor and depletion concealed beneath the recipient's visible life.

activation_trace.role: Favor and good condition anchor the life received as blessing.
The inside of a thing anchors gestation as a literal hidden site of benefit.
Interior pregnancy and fruit supply the concealed carrying process.
Loss of strength supplies the cost borne twice over beneath the resulting life.
A child separated from nursing supplies the temporal endpoint of dependent nourishment.
Recognition of favor and praise of the giver supplies the required response to hidden labor.

structural_cues: 31:12 introduces gratitude; 31:14 directs gratitude to God and parents after a two-year bodily sequence; 31:15 limits obedience without canceling good companionship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed carrying, cumulative weakness, weaning, and gratitude; I infer that hidden blessing includes another person's unobserved cost. Alternatively, the parental unit may exemplify obligation without defining the focus pair's full scope.

changed_reading.before: Inward blessings are private spiritual states or imperceptible divine gifts.
changed_reading.after: They also include embodied and relational costs hidden inside the visible life a beneficiary receives, so gratitude must look behind the finished benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: A mustard-weight hidden in rock or the cosmic domains remains retrievable because minuteness and concealment are matched by subtle access and knowledge of interiors; hiddenness therefore does not entail moral loss.

activation_trace.role: Concealed inward reality anchors the focus category being made dynamic.
Disclosure to a knower anchors the contrast between divine retrieval and unsupported dispute.
Measured weight supplies exact accountability at minute scale.
The mustard seed supplies the materially tiny trace.
Massive hard rock supplies maximal enclosure around the tiny trace.
Smallness, fineness, and hiddenness supply access at the trace's own scale.
Knowledge of an affair's interior supplies retrieval despite enclosure.

structural_cues: 31:16 moves one minute item through rock, heavens, and earth, then says God brings it forth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact weight, tiny seed, enclosure, subtlety, and interior knowledge; I infer concealment to retrieval to accountability. Alternatively, the example may concern divine omniscience broadly rather than specifically revising the focus blessings.

changed_reading.before: The inward is a static class of unseen benefit.
changed_reading.after: The inward is also a scale and location from which even the smallest consequential trace can be brought into disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cheek, gait, and voice are visible surfaces on which excessive inward self-estimation becomes legible; the focus pair can therefore diagnose congruence or leakage between inner posture and public conduct.

activation_trace.role: Public emergence anchors the outward behavioral surface.
Hidden inward reality anchors the posture disclosed through that surface.
Tilting cheek and neck away in pride supplies a facial disclosure of inner rank-making.
Joy exceeding its measure supplies the affect driving conspicuous movement.
Swagger in walking supplies the bodily performance of inward conceit.
Audible voice supplies another outward channel through which inward measure is tested.

structural_cues: 31:18-19 move from face to walking to vocal volume, making inward excess progressively observable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pride-marked face, gait, and sound; I infer inner posture to outer signal. Alternatively, these may remain discrete etiquette commands rather than a general account of visible and hidden blessing.

changed_reading.before: Outward and inward name separate gifts.
changed_reading.after: They can also name coupled dimensions of a person: inward orientation becomes inspectable in the use of outwardly bestowed body, movement, and voice.

context_deltas.mechanism: When revelation is proposed, inherited discovery and parental precedent become a substitute route; lack of guidance or illuminating book can thus coexist with confident participation in a socially transmitted path.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction to the true path anchors the missing criterion in the focus.
Binding inscription anchors the absent authority against which inherited practice could be tested.
Following behind supplies the mechanism of adopting a route from predecessors.
Finding something already present supplies inherited availability as its own warrant.
Fatherhood and upbringing supply the social channel through which the substitute path gains authority.

structural_cues: 31:21 directly contrasts following what God sent down with following what was found upon the fathers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two competing objects of following and an inherited chain; I infer social transmission as a replacement epistemology behind focus disputation. Alternatively, the focus disputant need not be identical with the ancestral followers.

changed_reading.before: No guidance or book means the disputant has no framework.
changed_reading.after: The disputant may have a powerful inherited framework, but it is a substitute route untested by the guidance and illuminating standard named in the focus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The alternative to verbal entanglement is staged bodily: hand over the face or orientation, act well, grasp, and settle trust in what is firm. Guidance becomes enacted alignment and reliable attachment.

activation_trace.role: Direction and intended course anchor guidance as orientation rather than information alone.
Tight twisting anchors the verbal entanglement answered by a firm attachment.
Handing over and releasing a thing supplies surrendered agency.
Direction and orientation supply what is surrendered and aligned.
Holding and retaining supply active attachment rather than passive assent.
Trust and repose in a support supply the reliability of the grasped orientation.

structural_cues: 31:22 sequences surrendered face, beneficent action, the branchless ع ر و handhold construction, firmness, and final outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies orientation, surrender, grasp, and trust; I infer a bodily counter-mechanism to disputation. Alternatively, the handhold may summarize fidelity without mapping each focus epistemic term onto a bodily operation.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is mainly correct content missing from an argument.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is also an embodied orientation one entrusts, performs, and holds, contrasting with argument that only tightens around itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers can correctly name God as creator of heavens and earth and still be classified as not knowing; knowledge in the focus is therefore integrated recognition with consequences, not possession of one correct proposition.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower anchors the disputed meaning of knowledge in the focus.
Reflection and considered judgment anchor the integration demanded beyond bare sight.
Disclosure to a knower is explicitly denied after the correct creator-confession, separating answer from integrated recognition.

structural_cues: 31:25 asks who created the same heavens and earth named in 31:20, records the answer Allah, then says most do not know.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a correct answer followed by denied knowledge; I infer proposition without integration. Alternatively, 'most do not know' could target further facts or consequences not the status of their stated answer itself.

changed_reading.before: The disputant lacks the proposition that God created the cosmos.
changed_reading.after: The disputant may confess that proposition yet fail to let it organize gratitude, allegiance, and argument, which is the deeper absence of knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pens and repeatedly supplied seas cannot exhaust divine words; the illuminating book becomes a finite, usable aperture into an inexhaustible semantic source, not a claim that revelation contains divine reality by exhaustion.

activation_trace.role: Joined letters and writing anchor the bounded textual medium in the focus.
Illumination anchors the medium's clarifying function rather than exhaustive capacity.
A prepared writing reed supplies the finite inscription instrument.
Vast abundant water supplies an immense writing reservoir.
Ink that keeps supplying a pen turns the reservoir into continued inscription.
Exhaustion and ending supply the limit explicitly denied of the words.
Meaningful expressions supply what remains inexhaustible despite every material writing aid.

structural_cues: 31:27 repeatedly enlarges writing material and then denies that divine words reach an endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finite pens, multiplied ink, and inexhaustible words; I infer book as a clarifying interface rather than exhaustive container. Alternatively, the plenitude image may praise divine speech without qualifying the function of the focus book.

changed_reading.before: An illuminating book is a complete store of propositions used to end dispute.
changed_reading.after: It is a bounded but genuinely clarifying interface that orients readers within divine meaning precisely without exhausting that meaning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night enters day and day enters night while subjected luminaries run to a fixed term; cosmic service is a dynamic, timed circulation in which concealment and disclosure continually exchange places.

activation_trace.role: Directed taming anchors the focus claim that creation serves an ordered purpose.
Emergence anchors the disclosed phase of the alternating cycle.
Concealment anchors the hidden phase of the alternating cycle.
One thing entering inside another supplies reciprocal temporal interpenetration.
Directed subjection makes sun and moon moving instances of the focus system.
Flowing motion supplies continuous operation rather than static availability.
A fixed temporal limit supplies bounded duration and schedule.

structural_cues: 31:29 repeats the focus opening أَلَمْ تَرَ and its subjection claim, then renders both as alternating and time-bounded processes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal entry, moving luminaries, and a term; I infer concealment to disclosure as a service cycle. Alternatively, night and day may exemplify subjection without redefining the focus's outward and inward blessings.

changed_reading.before: Subjection is a static inventory of useful cosmic objects.
changed_reading.after: Subjection is scheduled process: useful order arises from continuous motion, alternating visibility, and limits that no beneficiary controls.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blessing carries the ship visibly, but an overhead wave covers the passengers and strips allegiance to an exclusive interior; rescue then discloses divided constancy, denial, and betrayal. Benefit and danger together stress-test what was hidden.

activation_trace.role: Favor and good condition anchor the blessing whose operation is tested at sea.
Hidden inward reality anchors the allegiance exposed under pressure.
A vessel moving in water supplies the material carrier of visible benefit.
Favor explicitly supplies the enabling condition of the vessel's passage.
An overlying cover supplies crisis as sudden occlusion of the ordinary visible world.
Intermixed turbulence supplies destabilizing pressure around the passengers.
Exclusive separation from association supplies the interior allegiance crisis brings to the surface.
Obedience and yielding identify that exposed allegiance as enacted commitment.
Denial despite knowledge supplies post-rescue suppression of what crisis disclosed.
Betrayal and failure to fulfill supply the reversal after deliverance.

structural_cues: 31:31 repeats أَلَمْ تَرَ and blessing; 31:32 moves from covering wave to exclusive appeal to rescue to mixed response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enabled travel, totalizing danger, exclusive devotion, rescue, denial, and betrayal; I infer crisis reveals an interior that safety can conceal again. Alternatively, the sequence may contrast situational behaviors without claiming a stable hidden self.

changed_reading.before: Outward and inward blessings are benefits received in two domains.
changed_reading.after: Blessing is also an exposure device: its interruption and restoration reveal whether inward allegiance corresponds to the visible claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final inventory places hour, rain, wombs, tomorrow's acquisition, and place of death beyond ordinary self-knowledge; the focus summons reading of hidden blessing without licensing total penetration of the hidden.

activation_trace.role: Eye-and-insight perception anchors the focus invitation whose reach is being bounded.
Hidden inward reality anchors the domain that cannot all be opened by human reflection.
Disclosure to a knower anchors the epistemic standard denied of unsupported dispute.
Presence with and proximity assign the listed knowledge to God.
Disclosure to a knower frames the inventory as asymmetrically known.
Life-giving rain from the sky supplies a blessing whose timing and descent remain controlled knowledge.
Practical knowing is twice denied to the self regarding tomorrow and death-place.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supply the unknowable content of tomorrow.
Loss of life supplies the unknowable terminal event and location.

structural_cues: 31:34 closes with repeated وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌ and pairs divine knowledge with human uncertainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a final asymmetry between divine and human knowing; I infer a boundary on the baseline's two-layer seeing. Alternatively, the list may concern future particulars only and leave broad inference about hidden blessings unrestricted.

changed_reading.before: Proper reflection can in principle uncover both outward and inward blessing.
changed_reading.after: Reflection can recognize hidden dependence and effects, but some interiors and futures remain irreducibly God's knowledge; the verse opposes groundless certainty as much as inattentiveness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The unpaid-labor sense is surprising because the focus form conventionally describes divine ordering, yet it remains anchored in the supplied branch for سخر and exposes the moral friction inside 'for you.' Render it only as an ethical resonance about entitlement, never as a replacement gloss or a claim that the verse condemns cosmic use.

activation_trace.role: A worker compelled without wages supplies an exploratory social shadow to creation's service 'for you.'

changed_reading.before: Cosmic service grants uncomplicated entitlement to use.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, gifted service warns beneficiaries not to reproduce gratitude-less conscription in their own relations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Turning an affair from back to belly is surprising because it is an idiomatic branch rather than the direct adjective sense, but the focus places the same two roots side by side after a command to perceive. Render it as an interpretive procedure, not as a lexical translation of ظاهرة وباطنة.

activation_trace.role: Deliberation and reflection supply the operation of inspecting more than a first surface.
Turning an affair from back to belly supplies a reversible inspection procedure.
The hidden interior supplies the side reached when the apparent benefit is turned over.

changed_reading.before: Outward and inward are two bins of blessings.
changed_reading.after: They can cue a method: turn each apparent benefit over, inspect its concealed dependencies and costs, then return to the visible whole with a changed judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The mark and aperture images come from form-distant split mappings of the focus sky root, so treating them as direct senses would be unsound. They remain worth carrying as a packet-authorized material analogy: qualify the heavens as 'as though' a marked, permeable interface through which hidden provision becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark from which condition is inferred supplies the sky as a readable sign-surface.
A narrow aperture through which something enters supplies permeability between hidden source and visible benefit.
Abundant water that wets through supplies material transmission from interface to recipient.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are only the upper container of subjected things.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, they become a marked and permeable interface where hidden provision leaves visible effects and passes into lived blessing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The intergroup-conflict branch of نور is surprising and form-distant from مُنِير, but its adjacency to entangled disputation gives it a traceable social mechanism. Render it only as a secondary contrast: illumination can prevent argumentative heat from becoming communal fire; do not gloss مُنِير as conflict.

activation_trace.role: Entangled contest supplies the argumentative heat requiring containment.
A blaze of conflict between groups supplies the social failure that absent illumination may permit.
Joining one thing to another supplies a shared textual medium capable of holding disputants to common relations.

changed_reading.before: The illuminating book only supplies private intellectual clarity.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, its illumination also functions publicly by keeping braided disagreement from igniting into a social blaze.

strongest_changes: The 31:6 syntactic mirror turns unsupported disputation into the downstream product of an attention market that buys distraction, leaves the path, and rewards ridicule.
Maternal carrying and the mustard-seed scene make the outward/inward pair concrete as concealed cost and minute retrievable consequence, not merely visible versus spiritual gifts.
Night/day and the sea sequence turn subjection from static inventory into timed process and turn blessing into a crisis test that exposes interior allegiance.
The final knowledge inventory bounds the opening invitation to see: hidden dependence can be recognized without claiming access to every hidden future.
summary.what_was_special: The focus pair ظاهرة وباطنة kept changing domain without losing its anchor: cosmic mechanics, maternal embodiment, moral scale, bodily conduct, temporal alternation, and crisis disclosure. Meanwhile علم, هدى, and كتاب منير remained distinct tests rather than collapsing into generic evidence.
remaining_uncertainties: 31:10 may deny pillars altogether rather than imply unseen pillars, so hidden support is retained at the level of operation, not invisible columns.
The repeated وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن may link one rhetorical type across 31:6 and 31:20 or may only juxtapose separate examples.
The split-root and distant-branch outliers are useful material analogies but should not be promoted into direct lexical glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The cosmos is made serviceable, not merely possessed.** **س خ ر B001** is bringing under command for a purpose; **س م و B004** and **ء ر ض B001** provide upper and lower domains; **ن ع م B001** is bestowed favor. The repeated “what is in” gathers both domains into a beneficiary relation. I infer that subjection is purposive availability for human action, not transfer of absolute ownership. The opening becomes a responsibility-laden service system.
2. **Favor forms a complete outer-inner covering.** **س ب غ B001–B002** supplies completion and breadth that covers; **ظ ه ر B001/B003** what comes into view and the outer surface; **ب ط ن B001–B002** inside and hidden reality. The paired participles divide an otherwise full covering into visible and interior layers. I infer that perception samples only one surface of a completed provision. “He lavished” thus reads as enveloping sufficiency whose hidden layer exceeds inspection.
3. **Disputation twists where three orienting media are absent.** **ج د ل B001–B002** is firm twisting/interlacing and contentious dispute; **ع ل م B001–B002** clear knowledge and its mark; **ه د ي B001–B002** guidance and intended course; **ك ت ب B001–B003** joined writing and binding inscription; **ن و ر B001/B005** illumination and beacon. The triple negation removes mark, route, and stable luminous record. I infer that argument without these constraints folds back on itself rather than advancing. The line reads disputation as structurally twisted discourse, not mere disagreement.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 31:31 concretized subjection and favor in the ship’s running, turning the cosmic service claim into a vulnerable human-scale mechanism. Ayah 31:34 then completed the outer-inner pair with rain, gestation, intention, gain, and death as processes whose decisive layer remains unseen.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Complete blessing as a visible-hidden evidence field.** Lexical evidence: `س ب غ B001` is completion, fullness, and sufficiency, `ظ ه ر B001` is coming into view, and `ب ط ن B002` is hidden inward reality. Structural cue: the blessing is singularly attributed yet distributed across opposed outer and inner modes; 31:16 has already placed a minute object in hidden locations, and 31:23 will locate knowledge inside breasts. Assigned role: fullness spans what observation can inventory and what only inward testing can reach. Abductive move (inferred): a blessing is complete not because every item is visible, but because its support operates across both layers. Reading change: divine favor reads as a layered epistemic environment rather than a collection of obvious goods.

2. **Subjection as dependence-producing service, not ownership.** Lexical evidence: `س خ ر B001` is bringing something under command so it becomes serviceable. Structural cue: the service is `لَكُم`, but 31:18 has prohibited swaggering on the very earth being made serviceable, and 31:25 will force admission of its creator. Assigned role: the subjected cosmos enables human action while retaining another's command as its source. Abductive move (inferred): benefiting from ordered service makes the beneficiary dependent on that order rather than sovereign over it. Reading change: cosmic availability becomes a reason for recognition and responsibility, not a license for domination.

3. **A tightly twisted argument without epistemic anchors.** Lexical evidence: `ج د ل B001/B002` is firm rope-like twisting and contentious back-and-forth; `ع ل م B002` is a distinguishing marker, `ه د ي B001` is indication toward a way, `ك ت ب B002` is joined written text, and `ن و ر B001` is illumination. Structural cue: three negated resources follow the dispute: no marker, no direction, and no illuminating record. Assigned role: argument supplies tight verbal form, while the missing triad would have supplied orientation and external check. Abductive move (inferred): formal coherence can be produced by twisting claims together even when no evidence anchors them. Reading change: the disputant's problem is not lack of verbal structure but structure detached from every validating source.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - 31:21 gave the unanchored dispute a concrete content: inherited finding replaces descended guidance. 31:23 sharpened hidden blessing through knowledge of breast-interiors, and 31:25 showed that even a correct spoken answer can remain `لَا يَعْلَمُونَ`, confirming the gap between argument and integrated knowledge.

baseline.text: Allah'ın göklerde ve yerde olanları hizmetinize verdiğini, açık ve gizli nimetlerini üzerinize bolca yaydığını görmediniz mi? İnsanlardan kimi hiçbir bilgisi, yol göstericisi ve aydınlatıcı kitabı olmadan Allah hakkında tartışır.

findings.text: Göklerin ve yerin hizmete verilmesi mutlak mülkiyet devri değil, insanı yararlandığı düzenin kaynağına karşı sorumlu kılan amaçlı bir kullanılabilirliktir.
Nimetin açık ve gizli yüzleri, insanın yalnızca dış yüzeyi görebildiği halde desteğin iç katmanlarda da tamamlandığını gösterir.
Bilgi işareti, yön ve aydınlatıcı kayıt bulunmadığında tartışma ilerlemek yerine kendi üzerine kıvrılan, sıkı fakat doğrulanmamış bir söz örgüsüne dönüşür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
Bir şeyi gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan ve tanık olarak görme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözle görmeyi temel alır ve bazı anlatımlarda bu algıyı içsel kavrayışa kadar genişletir; doğrudan göz tanıklığı özellikle belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: gözle ya da içsel kavrayışla görme

error_profile.loses: İçsel kavrayışla görme olanağını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak ekseni, bir konu hakkında zihinsel bir yargı veya görüş oluşturmaktır. Bilme ya da sanma değeri belirli tümce yapılarında, danışma ise başka birinin görüşünü istemede ortaya çıkar; bunlar yalın çekirdeğin eş düzeyli anlamları sayılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görüş, kanı ve düşünerek karar verme çekirdektir; bilme, sanma ve danışma yapıya bağlı gerçekleşimlerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın zihinsel yargı ile düşünme, danışma ve göz tanıklığına bağlı sanma kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir konu hakkında düşünüp zihinde bir görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturmaktır. Derinlemesine düşünme bu sonuca götüren süreçtir; danışma başka birinin yargısını isteme, belirli tümce yapılarıysa bilme ya da sanma değeridir.

facets.statement: Bir konu hakkında zihinde görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturma.
Bir görüşe ulaşmak için konuyu ağır ağır ve farklı yönleriyle düşünme.
Başka birinden görüş isteme veya belirli bir yapıda bilme ve sanma bildirme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar zihinsel görüş ve inancı ortaklaştırır; düşünerek görüşe varma, bir başkasına danışma ve belirli yapılardaki bilme ya da sanma değerleri bu eksenin bağlı gerçekleşimleridir.
